g.text: Service Discovery: who finds a healthy instance, and how
Server-side (LB queries the registry) vs. client-side (caller queries it directly)
Getting INTO the registry: self-registration (instance calls the registry on startup -- simple, but a crash
that skips deregistration leaves a stale entry) vs. third-party registration (an orchestrator like Kubernetes
registers instances for you, based on what it already knows it deployed -- no instance-side code needed).
Health checking keeps the registry honest: a HEARTBEAT/TTL entry expires if not renewed (Instance 3, above),
or an active check polls each instance directly. Without this, callers keep getting routed to an instance
that's still 'registered' but has actually stopped working.
